description: Resolve a workflow run that is paused at a gate step (see pendingGateStepId on the run). approve lets the run continue; reject stops it; amend continues with operator guidance (pass it in comment). Requires the `approve` scope — the same gate as crew HIL decisions.

comment.description: Optional note; carries the guidance for an amend.

runId.description: The workflow run id waiting at a gate.

name: anyforge_resolve_workflow_gate
title: Resolve workflow gate
